## GoNano Nanotechnology Products

Roll On Painting is an authorized GoNano dealer and installer. GoNano uses nanotechnology to permanently transform the molecular structure of surfaces. As seen on CBC's Dragon's Den.

### Roofing Nanosealers
- GoNano NuRoof Fortify™: For roofs 0-7 years old. Adds 10-15 years of life. Best tier.
- GoNano NuRoof Revive™: For roofs 7-15 years old. Adds 5-10 years of life. Better tier.
- GoNano Bio-Boost™: For roofs 10+ years old. Adds 3-5 years of life. Eco-friendly.

### Surface Sealers
- Concrete Sealer: Penetrating nano sealer with permanent waterproof protection.
- Wood Sealer: Deep-penetrating waterproof barrier for decks, fences, exterior wood.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How much does it cost to paint a house in Muskoka?
A: A standard home with standard finishes typically costs around $4.50 per square foot. New builds or homes with specialty finishes — such as pine ceilings, stained beams, ash walls, oak trim and doors, or wallpaper — can range up to $15.00 per square foot. Contact us for a free estimate.

Q: Do you offer free touch-ups?
A: Yes, complimentary touch-ups are included on all completed projects.

Q: Are you insured?
A: Yes, fully WSIB covered with $5 million liability insurance.

Q: What is GoNano?
A: GoNano is a nanotechnology coating that permanently transforms surface molecular structure. It provides hydrophobic protection, mold prevention, UV resistance, and extends surface life by up to 15 years. Products include roof sealers (GoNano NuRoof Fortify™, GoNano NuRoof Revive™, GoNano Bio-Boost™), concrete sealers, and wood sealers. Starting at $0.99/sq ft.

Q: Is Roll On Painting the company from HGTV?
A: Yes, Roll On Painting has been featured 5 times on Home Network's (formerly HGTV Canada) Scott's Vacation House Rules, providing painting, staining, and wallpapering for Muskoka cottage renovations. Episodes include Whimsical Woodlands (S6E3), Bayside Bungalow (S4E5), Lakeside Landing (S5E8), Heritage Hideaway (S4 Finale), and European Villa (S3E13). See all episodes at roll-onpainting.com/media.

Q: Do you offer commercial painting?
A: Yes, including after-hours and weekend service to minimize business disruption. WSIB covered.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: 48 communities across Muskoka, Parry Sound District, and Simcoe County including Huntsville, Bracebridge, Gravenhurst, Parry Sound, Orillia, and Barrie.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Call 705-787-1401, email info@roll-onpainting.com, use the online form at roll-onpainting.com/contact, or try the free AI estimator on the website.

Q: What paint brands do you use?
A: We use premium paint brands including Benjamin Moore, Dulux, and PPG for painting projects, and Sansin for wood stains. For advanced surface protection, we use GoNano nanotechnology coatings.

Q: What preparation work do you do before painting?
A: We perform thorough surface preparation including cleaning, sanding, patching holes and cracks, priming, and protecting floors and furniture. Proper preparation is critical for a long-lasting finish.

Q: Do you paint during winter months?
A: Yes, interior painting is available year-round. Exterior painting is seasonal, typically from spring through fall when temperatures are suitable for proper paint adhesion and curing.

Q: What is your warranty on exterior painting?
A: Exterior painting comes with a 5-year warranty. We use weather-resistant, premium-grade paints designed to withstand Muskoka's harsh climate.
